method.knd001: All KND001 diagnostics are checked using the independent oracle, bound to the original source hashes and frozen mappings. The agent separately inspected opening lines or complete frontmatter of the first 120 holdout KND001 IDs in ascending SHA-256 order and checked their paths against the profile.
method.conventions: The agent read the full relevant sentences, surrounding sections, page openings, and frozen responsibilities for every emitted STL001 and PTR001 diagnostic. Each decision uses the narrow rule contract, distinguishing ordinary table identifiers, compatibility descriptions, examples, and metaphors from actual current-state claims or directing pointers.
method.manual_review_scope: 133 diagnostics: 120 sampled holdout KND001 plus all 13 convention diagnostics across both splits. KND001 header inspection is not full-page semantic review. No human review is claimed.
method.holdout_integrity: Profiles, source bytes, rule implementation, and emitted report were not changed in response to these diagnostic judgments.
method.limitations: KND001 results measure declaration/mapping consistency under the selected evaluation profile; they do not prove the profile reflects an upstream authors intent or validate conventions on unknown-kind documents.

oracle.mapping_semantics: Case-sensitive literals and single-component stars; unsupported syntax fails closed.
oracle.scope: Field presence and effective mapping consistency only; no judgment of an upstream author's intended kind or the quality of their documentation.
